game.name: Naughty Bear (USA)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Naughty Bear is a very special action/adventure game for Xbox 360. Taking place in a dreamlike world populated by charming teddy bears, the player embodies Naughty Bear, an outcast rejected by his fellow bears. Your objective: to take revenge on your fellow citizens by terrorising them or even killing them in a particularly cruel manner. You will also have to triumph over the bosses in each of the seven worlds of the game.
